title: RUIBench: What Makes a Good Robot-Use Interface?
abstract: arXiv:2611.31115v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Foundation models can reason about complex physical tasks, yet translating this intelligence into reliable robot execution remains challenging. We argue that a critical, often overlooked factor is the robot-use interface (RUI), which determines how agents express and execute physical actions. To systematically study its impact, we introduce RUIBench, comprising 30 manipulation tasks across five suites spanning world knowledge, in-context learning, discovery, dynamic interaction, and contact-rich manipulation. We further develop RUIKit, a unified framework that crosses six action abstractions with two interaction forms, yielding 13 interfaces under shared perception and control. In simulation, changing only the RUI shifts a frontier agent's success rate from 45% to 81%, and that of a fine-tuned 4B model from 13% to 47%. translated_title: RUIBench：什么才是好的机器人使用接口？
translated_abstract: 基础模型能够对复杂物理任务进行推理，但如何将这种智能转化为可靠的机器人执行仍然充满挑战。我们认为一个关键但常被忽视的因素是机器人使用接口（RUI），它决定了智能体如何表达和执行物理动作。为了系统地研究其影响，我们提出了RUIBench，包含30个操作任务，分为五个测试套件，涵盖世界知识、上下文学习、发现、动态交互和富接触操作。我们进一步开发了RUIKit，这是一个统一框架，将六种动作抽象与两种交互形式交叉组合，在共享的感知与控制下生成13种接口。在仿真实验中，仅改变RUI就能使前沿智能体的成功率从45%提升至81%，使微调后的4B模型的成功率从13%提升至47%。我们的分析表明，有效的接口能够减少不必要的决策，同时保留关键的反馈……
tldr: 该论文提出RUIBench基准和RUIKit统一框架，系统研究了机器人使用接口（RUI）对基础模型执行物理任务的影响，发现仅改变接口设计就能将智能体任务成功率从45%提升至81%，有效的接口应在减少不必要决策的同时保留关键反馈。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RUIBench and RUIKit, a systematic study showing that the robot-use interface (RUI) critically impacts task success rates—changing only the interface boosts a frontier agent's success rate from 45% to 81%, with effective interfaces reducing unnecessary decisions while preserving essential feedback.
